openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation reported in any result. Address lead: Lvivska St 49, Sviatoshynskyi district, Kyiv (osvita.ua directory guide/67 and ruwiki; third-party, undated). 'Operating' rests on official pages on kymu.edu.ua being returned by search (metadata 'about a year old') and a 2025 intake listing on vstup.osvita.ua; no dated 2026 statement on teaching was seen.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Severe name confusion with Kyiv Medical University (KMU, kmu.edu.ua, private, Kyiv): four of six searches returned KMU pages for a КиМУ/KyIU query; the official abbreviation 'KyMU' differs from 'KMU' by one letter. Every fact must be checked for which institution it belongs to.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Licence-annulment searches surface Kyiv Slavonic University (licence annulled) and other Kyiv private institutions; no annulment result names Kyiv International University, but no positive licence record was returned either.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No English-medium teaching lead for any health programme; the Preparatory Division is described as a Ukrainian-language course. A directory for English-speaking applicants must not imply English-medium Medicine or Dentistry.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No NAQA accreditation or EDEBO licence lead for 222 Medicine or 221 Dentistry; the official 'Rules for admitting foreigners' admit foreigners only to 'accredited educational programmes', so accreditation status is decisive and unverified. The 'accredited IV level' claim comes from an undated Russian-language wiki using the abolished accreditation-level system.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The official rules page is summarised as citing a June 1994 decree and requiring 'no less than 3 000$ (three thousand dollars) in cash or in bank account' at customs – possibly outdated legal basis; no deadlines or intake dates stated.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Official page metadata described as 'about a year old'; fee figures (42,000 UAH 2024; 45,500 UAH 2025, dentistry) come only from the third-party vstup.osvita.ua aggregator.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The 'College of KyIU' (фаховий коледж, college.kymu.edu.ua) trains pharmacy and dentistry at college level; these must not be presented as degree programmes, and pharmacy at degree level is unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Third-party page jamiemcatee.com 'kyiv international university tuition fees' is low-reliability (flagged by the search tool) and appears to conflate KyIU with KMU/International European University; do not use.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Official domain kymu.edu.ua is supported by own-domain search results and osvita.ua/Wikipedia, but no government record ties the name to the domain.
Missing evidence: EDEBO register entry: legal name, EDRPOU code, licence volumes for 222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry, 223 Nursing, 226 Pharmacy, and permission to train foreigners.
Missing evidence: NAQA accreditation decisions for the Medicine and Dentistry programmes (the official rules admit foreigners only to accredited programmes).
Missing evidence: Language of instruction for Medicine and Dentistry – no English-medium lead exists; the only language lead is a Ukrainian-language preparatory course.
Missing evidence: Official tuition pages and 2026/27 admission dates, deadlines and document lists (fees seen only on third-party 2024/2025 listings).
Missing evidence: A dated 2026 official statement that teaching is running (official pages carry 'about a year old' metadata).
Missing evidence: Whether Pharmacy exists at degree level or only at the College of KyIU (фаховий коледж).
Missing evidence: The main university record (not just the preparatory-department sub-page) on the Ministry portal or in EDEBO; today's searches did not re-return the portal page.
Missing evidence: A government record tying the legal name to kymu.edu.ua.
Missing evidence: The institution's own official English legal name and the identity of its founder/owner (ruwiki names rector Khachaturian Kh.V.; founder not confirmed).

Skeptic's note: Open (not a bar): no EDEBO licence or NAQA accreditation lead for 222 Medicine or 221 Dentistry; the official foreigner-admission rules admit foreigners only to accredited programmes, so this is decisive for later publication.
Skeptic's note: No English-medium teaching lead for any health programme (the Preparatory Division is Ukrainian-language); the page must not imply English-medium Medicine.
Skeptic's note: Pharmacy at degree level unverified: the College of KyIU (фаховий коледж) trains pharmacy/dentistry at college level and must not be presented as degree programmes.

Skeptic's note: Severe name confusion with Kyiv Medical University (KMU, kmu.edu.ua, candidate kyiv-medical-university): most results for КиМУ queries return KMU pages; my search again returned KMU listings alongside KyIU's.
